svg.title: From transcript to decoder targets
svg.desc: The 201-character transcript of 103-1240-0000 becomes 201 character tokens, 74 with the 1k BPE vocabulary, 54 with 5k and 48 with 10k. The 10k pieces are shown, followed by teacher forcing: the decoder reads [SOS] plus the tokens and must predict the tokens plus [EOS], one position ahead.
svg.text: SAME TRANSCRIPT, FOUR VOCABULARIES · tokens needed
Fewer tokens mean shorter decoder sequences
and fewer decoding steps at inference.
THE 48 TOKENS · “·” marks a token that starts a new word
TEACHER FORCING · the decoder reads one row and is trained to output the other
Both rows have 49 positions. Padding uses PAD (id 0), which the cross-entropy ignores; a causal mask stops position t from seeing inputs after t.
